item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Nitya explores the diagram of rectangle $PQRS$. She wants to study its diagonals.

Which claim correctly says which corners to join and what to compare?

options.A: Join opposite corners $P$ to $R$ and $Q$ to $S$, then compare those diagonal lengths and the angles they form.
options.B: Join adjacent corners $P$ to $Q$ only, because a diagonal is any side of the rectangle.
options.C: Join $P$ to $S$ and call that the only diagonal, reversing which corners count as opposite.
options.D: Compare only the labels $P$ and $R$ printed on the page as if they were the diagonals.
